newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telebras up in quiet ADR trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telebras up in quiet ADR trade.

text.p: A rise in Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras highlighted quiet trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on Friday.
"It was very, very quiet this morning. I don't think there is anything really going on at all," a trader said.

Telebras was up 1-1/4 to 84-3/4 in moderate late-morning trade, less than a point off a 12-month high of 85-3/8. The Brazilian bellwether has been boosted by a flood of new investment in Latin stocks and moves toward hooking up 11.1 million private cellular customers.
Among other Latin American ADRs, Telefonos de Mexico was up 3/8 to 38-5/8 in moderate volume.
Israel's Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd was up 1-11/16 to 55-15/16 in light trade and Britain's Hanson Plc was up 1/4 to 7-3/4, also in light trade.
Advancers led decliners by 259 to 242 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 33.2 million shares in late morning.
